html.p: Authentication activity, failed logins, out-of-hours access, privileged logons and high-risk Windows security events

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h | stats count as total_events
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-24h | stats count as successful_logins
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | stats count as failed_logins

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-24h | eval hour_num=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval weekday=strftime(_time,"%A") | where hour_num<8 OR hour_num>=18 OR weekday="Saturday" OR weekday="Sunday" | stats count as out_of_hours_logins
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h EventCode IN (1102,4720,4726,4728,4732,4740) | stats count as high_risk_events

panel.title: Successful vs Failed Logins Over Time

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-7d (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) | eval event_type=case( EventCode=4624,"Successful Login", EventCode=4625,"Failed Login" ) | timechart span=1h count by event_type

panel.title: Login and Logout Activity Over Time

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-7d (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4634) | eval event_type=case( EventCode=4624,"Login", EventCode=4634,"Logout" ) | timechart span=1h count by event_type

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-24h | eval username=coalesce(Account_Name, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, user, AccountName) | where isnotnull(username) AND username!="-" AND username!="" AND NOT like(username,"%$") | stats count as logins by username | sort - logins | head 10

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | eval username=coalesce(Account_Name, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, user, AccountName) | where isnotnull(username) AND username!="-" AND username!="" AND NOT like(username,"%$") | stats count as failed_logins by username | sort - failed_logins | head 10

panel.title: Top Source IPs for Failed Logins

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-24h | eval host_label=case( host=="ACS_PC_COPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", host=="ACS_PC_OPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", true(),host ) | eval source_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address, IpAddress, Workstation_Name, host_label) | stats count as failed_logins by source_ip | sort - failed_logins | head 10

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-7d | eval hour_num=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval weekday=strftime(_time,"%A") | where hour_num<8 OR hour_num>=18 OR weekday="Saturday" OR weekday="Sunday" | timechart span=1h count as "Out-of-hours Logins"

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 earliest=-7d | eval hour_num=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval weekday=strftime(_time,"%A") | where hour_num<8 OR hour_num>=18 OR weekday="Saturday" OR weekday="Sunday" | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S") | eval host_label=case( host=="ACS_PC_COPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", host=="ACS_PC_OPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", true(),host ) | eval username=coalesce(Account_Name, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, user, AccountName) | eval source_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address, IpAddress, Workstation_Name, host_label) | table Time host_label username source_ip Logon_Type | sort - Time | head 20
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=1102 earliest=-24h | stats count as audit_log_cleared
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4672 earliest=-24h | stats count as privileged_logons
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4740 earliest=-24h | stats count as account_lockouts
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h EventCode IN (4720,4726,4728,4732) | stats count as user_group_changes

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-7d EventCode IN (1102,4720,4726,4728,4732,4740) | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S") | eval host_label=case( host=="ACS_PC_COPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", host=="ACS_PC_OPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", true(),host ) | eval username=coalesce(Account_Name, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, user, AccountName) | eval event_description=case( EventCode=1102,"Audit Log Cleared", EventCode=4720,"User Account Created", EventCode=4726,"User Account Deleted", EventCode=4728,"User Added to Privileged Group", EventCode=4732,"User Added to Local Group", EventCode=4740,"Account Locked Out", true(),"Other High-Risk Event" ) | table Time host_label EventCode event_description username | sort - Time | head 30

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" earliest=-24h EventCode=4672 | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S") | eval host_label=case( host=="ACS_PC_COPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", host=="ACS_PC_OPS_02","WIN-SOC-LAB-01", true(),host ) | eval username=coalesce(Account_Name, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, user, AccountName) | table Time host_label EventCode username | sort - Time | head 30
